'''Decker''' was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Republic Army]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he held a rank of Provost in the [[Dead Man's Legion]], a unit of the [[Republic Army]] for men convicted of crime. Decker and his fellow [[Provost Marshal]] [[Fideltin Rusk]] took the Legion to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] on an assignment by the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Jebevel Madon]], where Rusk directed [[Private/Legends|Private]] [[Merghal]] to Decker for processing.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Decker is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' during the Rusk Alliance alert mission.<ref name="SWTOR" />
